invariants.statement: The candidate makes zero runtime requests outside its own origin.
acceptance_obligations: Reject any candidate runtime that contains or performs a remote HTTP request.

invariants.statement: The core bag preserves assigned foundation shade 185N and standard Invisimatte powder through checkout review.
acceptance_obligations: Reject unknown products, shades, sizes, and non-positive quantities without changing the cart.

invariants.statement: Checkout exposes opaque local simulations and no real payment credential fields or provider calls.
acceptance_obligations: Reject any checkout surface that accepts card numbers or invokes a real payment provider.

invariants.statement: Account, favorites, cart, addresses, and orders persist only in the fenty-beauty bound SQLite database.
acceptance_obligations: Reject cross-account reads, writes, or any database path shared with another site.

invariants.statement: Authenticated source states remain structural or unavailable; clone-local account states make no pixel-equivalence claim.
acceptance_obligations: Do not award source-visual parity credit to clone-local authenticated states without direct accepted source evidence.
